messages:
Lila (People Ops): quick note 5 Ethan from Hiring Ops is stepping down as contractor, last day 5/10. We need to hand off open reqs, ensure candidate desk accounts are closed, and confirm eligibility for rehiring later. Maya, can you take the requisitions?
Ethan (Hiring Ops): leaving on 5/10, happy to run a 1:1 KT with Maya and sync ATS tags + active candidates. please confirm which accounts to close.
Maya (Recruiter): I'll take the open reqs 132, 145, and 151. Ethan, can you export candidate progress and notes by 5/7?
Ethan (Hiring Ops): yes will export CSV and share via GDrive with recruiters. Also confirm: contractor has no benefits but we need to remove GSuite access and candidate ATS access.
Priya (IT): ticket IT-9401 opened to deprovision GSuite, Greenhouse, and Slack on 5/10 17:00 PT. If there are handoff inboxes, we'll transfer ownership before deprovision.
Diego (Legal): note for rehiring policy: contractors may be rehired after 90 days with manager approval. Will attach the rehiring policy link.
Alex (Security): remove any API tokens Ethan has to third-party job boards and rotate shared keys. Also please ensure no candidate PII is exported to personal accounts.
Ethan (Hiring Ops): I cleaned local downloads already. Will check for any candidate files and nuke personal copies.
Maya (Recruiter): rapid ask: are there any offer letters pending signature? We have one for candidate 145. Ethan, please confirm if you have the signature flow in progress.
Ethan (Hiring Ops): offer for 145 is awaiting candidate signature; will handoff to Maya by EOD.
Lila (People Ops): payroll note: contractor last invoice must be submitted by 5/12 to be included in next billing cycle.
Oncall Bot: reminder queued: remove Ethan from recruiter group and associated Slack channels at 17:05 PT on 2026-05-10.
Priya (IT): sample deprovision step (internal):
```
# disable google account
gam update user ethan.contractor@redwood.ai suspended on
# remove greenhouse access
greenhouse-api revoke --user ethan.contractor@redwood.ai
```
Diego (Legal): also reminder to archive any candidate communications that contain legal waivers. If anything requires retention longer than 2 years, flag me.
Maya (Recruiter): thanks Ethan 5 will schedule KT 5/8 10am.
Ethan (Hiring Ops): done. I'll share the CSV and transfer ATS ownership.
Lila (People Ops): closing: IT to deprovision 5/10 17:00, Maya to take over reqs, Legal note on rehiring policy, contractor invoice due 5/12. react :white_check_mark: once done.
